items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Etta was a member of the Dandridge Sisters, Dorothy Dandridge, the dancer.

ctx.x: Tell me about your relationship with Gerald.

With Gerald? Gerald’s always been a real close buddy of mine. I’ve known Gerald since he started – after – I guess he was still with the Lunceford band when I first met him. Of course we got in the Navy in ’42. That’s a long time ago right there. ’50-’60-’70-’80-’90, whew. That’s getting to be close to 60 years already. Gerald’s wife and my wife at the time – my wife passed in ’79, I think it was – m wife and Gerald’s
wife Etta were good friends. Etta was a member of the Dandridge Sisters, Dorothy Dandridge, the dancer.
